name: Question 7
worked_solution:
We distribute the disjunction over the conjunction, as follows:

$$
(¬X∧¬Y)∨Z≡(¬X∨Z)∧(¬Y∨Z)
$$

Question 7
?

Which statement is equivalent to (¬X∧¬Y)∨Z?

a
(¬X∧Z)∨(¬Y∧Z)
b
(¬X∨Z)∧¬Y
c
(¬X∨Z)∧(¬Y∨Z)
d
(¬X∨Z)∨(¬Y∨Z)
e
(¬X∨Z)∧(¬X∨¬Y)
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

We distribute the disjunction over the conjunction, as follows: (¬X∧¬Y)∨Z≡(¬X∨Z)∧(¬Y∨Z)
